title: tools.rerun request
description: plugin → companion, the payload of a `call` with op `tools.rerun`. Re-run a call the platform recorded, named by its `tool_call` URN, on the request the plugin is answering: the platform runs the recorded tool with the recorded arguments as a NEW call, through today's approvals. The companion refuses a request it did not ring (`not_permitted`) and never retries a call once sent: a tool is not idempotent.
